title: Java Text Editor Default Configuration
description: Contract for config/default.yml. It limits runtime configuration to the assignment's planned application, window, editor, and team settings.

title.description: Title shown by the Swing editor window.

width.description: Initial editor-window width in logical pixels.

height.description: Initial editor-window height in logical pixels.

fontFamily.description: Preferred font family for the text editing area.

fontSize.description: Preferred editor font size in points.

lineWrap.description: Whether the main text area wraps long lines.

defaultEncoding.description: Default encoding for plain-text files; constrained to assignment-supported standard encodings.

memberA.description: First team member; displayed by the About dialog.

memberB.description: Second team member; displayed by the About dialog.
